messages:
maria: heads up — saw a ~3x spike in fncall schema rejections in us-west canary starting ~10:12 UTC. Breaking some customer flows. :eyes:
ajay: any example errors? strict-validate or parse failures?
maria: strict-validate. sample: 2026-03-23T10:13:02Z validator=v2 fncall_id=abc123 route=canary-usw outcome=REJECT reason=TYPE_MISMATCH field=metadata.timestamp expected=string got=number
ajay: looks like canary model returned ints for timestamps. only RFC3339 fields?
maria: mainly timestamps + a few enum ids returned as numbers. Also saw ~40% reroute to degen/text, extra tokens billed and lower QA.
sam: which route gets billed when reroute happens? affects quota attribution.
ajay: current: billed to final (degen) route. origin route quota doesn't reflect token usage — causes undercounted rejects.
maria: ops sees spike in spend but canary quota unchanged. customers confused.
dev-console: propose new fields: fncall.validation.reason_id and routing.final_route_id. We can add dashboard columns and filters.
ajay: reason_id should be enum strings (TYPE_MISMATCH, MISSING_REQUIRED, UNEXPECTED_ARRAY). add fncall.validation.soft_fail boolean for permissive fallbacks.
sam: long-term: emit metric fncall.fallback.via_validator{origin,final,reason} for reconciliation. Short-term we need mitigation.
maria: options: 1) flip validator to soft-mode for canary (allow passthrough + tag) 2) pin canary model to previous build 3) block reroute and return client error. Leaning to (1).
ajay: soft-mode + tagging ok, but increase DLQ sampling from 1% to 25% for debugging full payloads.
dev-console: UI: add rollout toggle "soft-validate on reject" with tooltip; show badge in route list for active soft-validate + sample rate.
sam: avoid quota gaming: when soft-validate on, increment origin_route.reject_count and bill to final_route but emit reconciliation metric attributing cost back to origin for billing reports.
ajay: will add fncall.cost.attributed.{origin_route,final_route} and coordinate billing ingest change.
maria: add console alert when reject_rate >= 0.5% AND fallback_rate >= 10% during rollouts; customers missed silent cost spikes.
dev-console: will wire rule and runbook; need final field names.
ajay: I'll draft RFC for telemetry fields and migration plan for legacy indices.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary/us-west/2026-03-23-10:20 (image: inference:1.14.2)
maria: ajay, own short-term soft-mode toggle + metric tags? loop in SE for customers.
ajay: on it. will push soft-validate toggle by 10:30 and increase DLQ sampling.
sam: scheduling a 15m post-mortem at 11:00 to confirm metrics and billing attribution.
dev-console: adding dashboard filter + temporary badge before 10:45.
maria: adding rollout doc note about conservative schema strictness for canaries.
ajay: add tests for enum normalization + type coercion in validator v2.
maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
